mapper.select: select a.id, a.title, a.subtitle, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.cover_focus_y as coverFocusY, a.content as content, a.like_count as likeCount, a.author_id as authorId, u.username as authorName, u.image as authorAvatar, a.create_time as publishTime from article a join user u on u.id = a.author_id where a.is_delete = 0 and (#{lastCreateTime} is null or a.create_time < #{lastCreateTime} or (a.create_time = #{lastCreateTime} and a.id < #{lastId})) order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc limit #{size}

select a.id, a.title, a.subtitle, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.cover_focus_y as coverFocusY, a.content as content, a.like_count as likeCount, a.author_id as authorId, u.username as authorName, u.image as authorAvatar, a.create_time as publishTime, a.pinned_by_creator_at as pinnedByCreatorAt from article a join user u on u.id = a.author_id where a.is_delete = 0 and a.author_id = #{userId} and a.pinned_by_creator_at=0 and (#{lastCreateTime} is null or a.create_time < #{lastCreateTime} or (a.create_time = #{lastCreateTime} and a.id < #{lastId})) order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc limit #{size}

select a.id, a.title, a.subtitle, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.cover_focus_y as coverFocusY, a.content as content, a.like_count as likeCount, a.author_id as authorId, u.username as authorName, u.image as authorAvatar, a.create_time as publishTime from article a join user u on u.id = a.author_id where a.id = #{id} and a.is_delete = 0

select a.id, a.title, a.subtitle, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.cover_focus_y as coverFocusY, a.content, a.author_id as authorId, u.username as authorName, u.image as authorAvatar, a.like_count, a.create_time as publishTime, a.pinned_by_creator_at as pinnedByCreatorAt from article a join user u on a.author_id=u.id where a.author_id=#{authorId} and a.pinned_by_creator_at!=0 and a.is_delete=0 order by a.pinned_by_creator_at desc , a.id desc
